instructions_coverage.notes: 15 of 17 instructions.json entries are exercised by at least one scenario's criteria.json (strict mode, quoting, trap cleanup, check_command, readonly, stderr logging, timestamps, no hardcoded credentials, input validation, no useless cat, no ls|grep, no eval, die() helper, env shebang). Not covered by a checkable scenario: single-responsibility function structure and POSIX sh portability -- both are structural/portability preferences without a scriptable pass/fail signal in the current scenario set.
